contents.heading: What is included
contents.included: User-facing options, workspace settings, Raf presets, loadouts, library tracks and metadata, favorites, folder descriptors, play counts, and remembered playback positions.
contents.excluded: Media files, file and directory handles, artwork cache, lyrics, live meters, pattern snapshots, object URLs, temporary window state, update timestamps, and cross-window coordination state.
contents.privacy: Backups are not encrypted. They can contain filenames, paths, metadata, favorites, and listening progress.

fileTransfer.title: Send files under
fileTransfer.hint: Sends smaller audio and module files whole, then renders them on each listener. Larger files and all video soundtracks use the host’s Opus stream.

multiplayer.title: izci Multiplayer
multiplayer.hint: Lets this izci host or join a shared listening session. Firebase handles the handshake; audio travels directly between peers.
multiplayer.name: Name this izci
multiplayer.nameHint: Shown to hosts and clients in multiplayer sessions.

waitForClients.title: Wait for clients
waitForClients.hint: Before starting a track, waits until every connected listener has loaded its transferred file or tuned to the audio stream.

autoHost.title: Always host for peers
autoHost.hint: On every izci launch, silently starts hosting so paired devices can join without a code. No invite code is shown; use Host with invite code to share one.

restoreSession.title: Restore last session
restoreSession.hint: When izci closed in the middle of a multiplayer session, reconnects to the host or resumes hosting on the next launch.

turnUrl.title: TURN server
turnUrl.hint: Host-only relay endpoint, such as relay.example.net:3478 or turns:relay.example.net:5349. Listeners receive it with temporary credentials.

turnSecret.title: TURN authentication secret
turnSecret.hint: Host-only shared secret configured on the relay. Listeners receive encrypted temporary credentials and do not need this setting.

turnLifetime.title: TURN credential lifetime
turnLifetime.hint: Sets the expiry of credentials minted for each listener. Longer values better tolerate long sessions and reconnects.

forceTurn.title: Force TURN relay
forceTurn.hint: Uses relay candidates only on the host and listeners. Enable temporarily to verify the relay or keep enabled when direct routes must never be used.

maxListeners.title: Maximum guests
maxListeners.hint: Limits how many guests can connect to the host at once, whether or not audio streaming is enabled.

freeplay.title: Enable Freeplay
freeplay.hint: When both izci devices enable Freeplay and pair, the listener can browse and play this host’s library on an independent timeline. The agreement is remembered for future connections.

streamAudio.title: Send audio to listeners
streamAudio.hint: Sends eligible files for local playback and streams the rest from the host. The host’s volume and mute do not affect listeners.

postRaf.title: Send post-Raf audio
postRaf.hint: Applies the host’s Raf rack before streaming. When off, listeners receive pre-Raf audio and can apply their own Raf settings.

opusBitrate.title: Opus VBR bitrate
opusBitrate.hint: Sets the best-effort bitrate ceiling for each listener. Higher rates use more host bandwidth and encoding work.

audioBuffer.title: Listener audio buffer
audioBuffer.hint: Adds receiver delay to absorb network and mobile scheduling jitter. Increase it for cleaner playback; decrease it for faster control response.

diagnostics.heading: Connection diagnostics
diagnostics.signaling: Firebase only exchanges the invite, session descriptions, and ICE candidates. Playback controls, catalog data, artwork, and audio use the resulting peer connection.
diagnostics.direct: izci asks Cloudflare and Google STUN servers for public ICE candidates, then tries direct routes. When configured above, TURN adds a relay path for restrictive NAT or firewall combinations.
diagnostics.upnp: A static public IP or router UPnP does not guarantee success: Chromium chooses its own ICE ports and izci does not request a UPnP port mapping.
diagnostics.messages: Failure to gather candidates points to browser or network policy; local-only candidates point to STUN failure; candidates on both sides with no connection point to NAT or firewall filtering.
diagnostics.tailnet: A successful Tailscale connection may use tailnet addresses, router port mapping, or DERP. It does not prove that the same devices have a usable direct route with Tailscale off.

playCountThreshold.hint: Only tracks that are in the library update their play count.

panStrength.title: Pan strength
panStrength.hint: Below 100 narrows the image, above 100 widens it.

tempoFactor.title: Tempo factor
tempoFactor.hint: Changes module playback speed without changing pitch.

pitchFactor.title: Pitch factor
pitchFactor.hint: Adjusts playback pitch relative to the module's original tuning.

openWhenMaximized.title: Open when maximized
openWhenMaximized.hint: Switches the main window to Now Playing while it is maximized or fullscreen.

hideSideChrome.title: Hide side chrome after
hideSideChrome.hint: Fades the side tabs, pane fill, and close button after mouse inactivity.

artworkColors.title: Always use artwork colors
artworkColors.hint: Forces the focused player controls to use artwork colors. When off, Now Playing follows the main player setting.

autoTheater.title: Auto switch to Theater
autoTheater.hint: Uses the large focused lyrics layout while Now Playing is active.

autoFocusLyrics.title: Auto focus Lyrics tab
autoFocusLyrics.hint: Opens Now Playing directly to the lyrics view.

textSize.title: Pattern text size
textSize.hint: Scales tracker cells independently from the app interface font.

rowHeight.title: Row height
rowHeight.hint: Controls how densely pattern rows pass through the playhead.

channelWidth.title: Channel width
channelWidth.hint: Sets the horizontal room reserved for each formatted tracker channel.

follow.title: Follow the playhead
follow.hint: Scrolls automatically to keep the current row in view while a module plays.

alwaysCenter.title: Always center current row
alwaysCenter.hint: Adds space around the first and last rows so the playhead stays vertically centered for the entire pattern.

smoothScroll.title: Smooth playhead scrolling
smoothScroll.hint: Animates row centering instead of stepping directly to the current row.

channelNames.title: Show channel names
channelNames.hint: Adds module-provided names beside channel numbers when they are available.

highlightBeats.title: Highlight beat rows
highlightBeats.hint: Adds a subtle guide every four rows behind the moving playhead.

rowNumbers.title: Row numbers
rowNumbers.hint: Uses familiar hexadecimal tracker numbering or ordinary decimal values.

colors.title: Pattern colors
colors.hint: Colors notes, instruments, volume commands, and effects for easier scanning.

restore.title: Restore playback
restore.hint: Restores the current track and position after a reload. Position and state also resumes playback when Chromium allows it.

replayGain.title: ReplayGain
replayGain.hint: Applies streamed-file ReplayGain tags, preferring track or album gain when both are available.

manual.title: Fade manual track changes
manual.hint: Sets how much of the standard fade or crossfade duration applies when you choose Previous, Next, or another track.

mode.title: Track transition
mode.hint: Cuts directly, fades the outgoing track to silence, or overlaps adjacent tracks.

gapless.title: Gapless playback
gapless.hint: Prepares the next file before the current one ends. Turning this off also disables crossfade.

duration.title: Fade length
duration.hint: Sets the fade-out or overlap duration.

rememberProgress.title: Remember progress
rememberProgress.hint: Automatically resumes unfinished files at least this long when you return to them.

restartCurrentTrackOnPrevious.title: Previous restarts current track
restartCurrentTrackOnPrevious.hint: Restarts the current track when Previous is pressed after 3 seconds; press it again to go to the previous track.

playbackRate.title: Playback speed
playbackRate.hint: Changes the playback speed of streamed audio and video. Tracker modules use their own tempo and pitch controls.

trueSpeed.title: True speed
trueSpeed.hint: Disables timestretching so pitch rises or falls along with playback speed.

showTimeRemaining.title: Show time remaining
showTimeRemaining.hint: Shows how much of the current track is left instead of its total length.

seekWheelStep.title: Wheel seek step
seekWheelStep.hint: How many seconds each wheel notch scrubs over the seek bar.

logarithmicVolume.title: Logarithmic volume
logarithmicVolume.hint: Shapes the volume slider for gentler low-end changes.

enableRaf.title: Enable Raf
enableRaf.hint: Enables the built-in audio effects rack and shows Raf under Playback.

showRafToggle.title: Show Raf toggle in player bar
showRafToggle.hint: Shows the rack bypass control beside volume while Raf is enabled. Right-clicking it opens Raf options.

folderNesting.title: Folder nesting limit
folderNesting.hint: How many subfolder levels folder opens and folder drops traverse. Use 0 to read only files directly inside the selected folder.

verify.title: Verify added files
verify.hint: Check unknown file extensions in a separate muted OpenMPT player before adding them. When disabled, izci adds any unknown file as a tracker module and lets normal playback report whether it works. Official OpenMPT extensions are accepted directly either way.

deduplicatePlaylist.title: Deduplicate playlist additions
deduplicatePlaylist.hint: Skip tracks already in the playlist and repeated tracks within the same addition.

associatedFiles.title: Files opened with izci
associatedFiles.hint: Choose how files opened through operating-system file associations affect the current playlist.

favoriteToggle.title: Show favorite toggle
favoriteToggle.hint: Show a heart button after the transport controls for adding or removing the current track or module subsong from Favorites.

ratings.heading: Ratings
ratings.title: Enable track ratings
ratings.hint: Show half-star rating controls and the Rating library column. Turning this off hides ratings without deleting them.

autoResizeWindow.title: Auto resize window
autoResizeWindow.hint: Resizes an unsuitable player window to 1280 × 720 when video starts, then restores it when non-video playback begins.

autoEnterTheater.title: Auto enter theater
autoEnterTheater.hint: Opens video playback in theater automatically when a video starts.

style.title: Style
style.hint: Controls how the spectrum analyzer is drawn behind the full player bar.

colorSource.title: Color source
colorSource.hint: Uses the current artwork palette when available, otherwise falls back to the active theme.

height.title: Height
height.hint: Sets how far the analyzer can rise through the player background.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.hint: Sets how strongly the analyzer appears behind text, controls, and artwork.

frameCap.title: Frame cap
frameCap.hint: Limits how often every visualizer style redraws, from battery-friendlier motion to high-refresh displays.

normalization.title: Normalization
normalization.hint: Balances low, mid, and high frequency bands so bass-heavy or bright tracks still use the full visual range.

triangleCount.title: Triangle count
triangleCount.hint: Sets how many triangle shapes are kept active in the player background.

triangleMinSize.title: Minimum triangle size
triangleMinSize.hint: Sets the smallest triangle size as a percentage of the player bar height.

triangleMaxSize.title: Maximum triangle size
triangleMaxSize.hint: Sets the largest triangle size as a percentage of the player bar height.

triangleBaseSpeed.title: Base rise speed
triangleBaseSpeed.hint: Multiplies the baseline upward movement before rhythm response is applied.

triangleReactiveSpeed.title: Reactive rise speed
triangleReactiveSpeed.hint: Multiplies the extra upward speed added by amplitude and beat pulses.

triangleBorderWidth.title: Border thickness
triangleBorderWidth.hint: Sets a fixed outline width shared by every triangle, regardless of size.
